name: Sasha Kovalenko
scenario_title: An Evening in the Reading Room
action: Sasha takes the flyer from Oksana, studies it for a moment, then glances back at the laptop and the stack of files on the coffee table. They step slightly toward the door, shifting weight onto the steady leg. They speak with a calm, appreciative tone: 'This sounds like a good one—I taught that period years ago. I'll come, but I have a contract to finish tonight, so I may slip out during the Q&A. Let me grab my jacket.'
reason: Sasha was pulled between the unfinished contract review and the appeal of a reading on a topic they once taught, one they believed their grandfather would have wanted them to attend. Their leg felt steady, but the half-reviewed files reminded them of a past mistake when leaving work unfinished caused extra days of correction. Trusting Oksana's judgment and seeing the reading as a possible reset from contract fatigue, Sasha decided to attend with a self-imposed boundary: they would slip out during the Q&A to finish the contract.
